settings.form.engine.title: Engine mode
settings.form.engine.desc: Choose what this install runs: fully open source, only paid APIs, or both side by side. The mode is enforced on the server, so a locked engine can't be used from the API either.
settings.form.engineMode.bothBody: Every studio gets a Cloud / Open source switch. Use frontier paid models when you want them, your own GPU when you don't.
settings.form.engineMode.bothNeeds: A fal.ai or Replicate key and/or a ComfyUI server
settings.form.engineMode.openBody: Only open-weight models on your ComfyUI server. Paid models are hidden and blocked on the server, and nothing is sent to paid APIs.
settings.form.engineMode.cloudBody: Only hosted frontier models (Nano Banana, Seedance, Kling, Veo…). No GPU needed; open-source models are hidden.
settings.form.inactiveOpenOnly: Not used in Open source only mode
settings.form.inactiveCloudOnly: Not used in Paid APIs only mode
settings.form.cloud.title: Paid API configuration
settings.form.cloud.desc: One fal.ai key runs the Fuobe Originals in the cloud (Soul, DoP, Genjutsu, Cinema: open weights with their LoRAs) and the partner models: Nano Banana, Seedream, GPT Image, FLUX, Kling, Seedance, Veo 3.1, Wan, MiniMax, avatars and more. Replicate hosts a subset and is used as a fallback (or first, if you prefer it). Save & test checks a key before saving it.
settings.form.provider.autoHint: Tries fal.ai, then Replicate when a model is on both. Models only one provider hosts always use that one.
settings.form.provider.falHint: fal.ai whenever it hosts the model. Models only one provider hosts always use that one.
settings.form.provider.replicateHint: Replicate whenever it hosts the model. Models only one provider hosts always use that one.
settings.form.comfy.title: Open-source engine · ComfyUI
settings.form.comfy.hostedPre: Run every open-source workflow on your own graphics card. See
settings.form.comfy.localPre: Run every open-source workflow on your own GPU (or a rented one). Fuobe talks to ComfyUI's HTTP API and uploads inputs for you. See
settings.form.comfy.tail: for the models each one needs.
settings.form.comfy.workersNote: ComfyUI jobs run on your workers now.
settings.form.comfy.urlHint: Where ComfyUI listens; a local install is http://127.0.0.1:8188.
settings.form.comfy.tokenHint: Sent as a Bearer token, for ComfyUI behind a proxy.
settings.form.comfy.isoHint: A second ComfyUI for LatentSync 1.6 and ThinkSound, whose node packs can't share the main install. scripts/comfy/README.md shows how to start one.
settings.form.loras.desc: Looks, camera moves and effects add LoRA files to open models, on your GPU and in the cloud; an adapter is the LoRA an Original always loads (Fuobe Try-On's). Fuobe fetches the pinned version a run needs and shows each file's licence; what may run where is your call in Models & licences.
settings.form.loras.onComputer: Your ComfyUI is on your computer: put LoRA files in its models/loras folder. Fuobe tells you which ones a run needs.
settings.form.training.title: Training · AI-Toolkit
settings.form.training.pre: Train Soul IDs and Fuobe looks (LoRAs) on your own GPU with
settings.form.training.post: : free, and the file stays yours. Without it, train in the cloud on fal.ai, or download a training kit from the Train dialog.
settings.form.training.urlHint: Where AI-Toolkit's UI listens (in ai-toolkit/ui: npm run build_and_start). Test checks it answers.
settings.form.training.tokenHint: The AI_TOOLKIT_AUTH the trainer was started with, if any.
settings.form.training.dirHint: Where Fuobe writes the training photos. Blank: Fuobe's data folder, for an AI-Toolkit on this machine; on another machine, a folder both can read.
settings.form.textAi.title: AI helper · models and providers
settings.form.textAi.desc: The LLMs that write for Fuobe. Use (below) picks the one for the Enhance toggle, storyboards, translations and scripts, ad copy and brand research: Claude, a local model (Ollama, LM Studio, Unsloth Studio or another OpenAI-compatible server: fully open source), or the built-in offline rewriter. The Assist agent can also plan with the providers you add a key for (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, OpenRouter and more). In Open source only mode, Automatic skips Claude. Save & test checks a key or address before saving it.
settings.form.enhancer.autoHint: Claude when a key is set, then a local model, then the offline rewriter.
settings.form.enhancer.claudeHint: Claude through your Anthropic key (paid per use).
settings.form.enhancer.localHint: A local, open-source model (Ollama, LM Studio, Unsloth Studio or your own server). Claude is never called.
settings.form.enhancer.offlineHint: Built-in rules, no LLM. Text steps (translate, write) are off.
settings.form.textAi.anthropicHint: Test checks the key with a free model list call.
settings.form.connectors.title: Assist · connectors
settings.form.connectors.desc: Give Claude in Assist the tools of your other apps — docs, tasks, CRM, analytics — through their MCP servers (a URL and, usually, a token). Only Claude chats use them.
settings.form.notifications.title: Notifications
settings.form.notifications.desc: Get a heads-up from your browser when something you started finishes while you're in another tab or app. Saved in this browser; nothing is sent anywhere.
settings.form.security.title: Security
settings.form.security.desc: Protect this studio with a password, and create API tokens for scripts and agents. Off by default for local use.
settings.form.demo.title: Placeholder results
settings.form.demo.desc: Off unless you turn it on. For giving a tour of this studio without keys or a GPU: runs cost nothing and make stand-in media instead of the real thing.
settings.form.demo.body: While it’s on, every run makes a placeholder labelled “Placeholder”, even with keys or ComfyUI connected, and the top bar says “Placeholders on”. While it’s off, a run with nothing connected asks you to connect ComfyUI or add a key.
settings.form.autoImage.title: Auto image model
settings.form.autoImage.desc: Auto is the Image studio's first pick on the open engine: Ideogram 4 for most pictures and for lettering, Qwen-Image 2.1 for edits, and Krea 2 Realism for the prompts below, which Ideogram 4's safety filter often declines. When Ideogram 4 declines a run anyway, Krea 2 Realism, FIBO 2 Dev, then MOSS-Image make it.
settings.form.models.desc: Every model, LoRA and node pack with its licence, as information. Everything is on: switch off a model, a whole kind of licence (say, all non-commercial ones), a provider or a node pack, and it leaves the pickers and is refused on the server.
settings.form.about.desc: The open models, LoRAs and code Fuobe is built on, who made them and their licences, and Fuobe's own source code.
settings.form.llm.autoHint: Uses the first server that answers with a model, in this order: Ollama, LM Studio, Unsloth Studio, then the Other server.
settings.form.llm.pinnedHint: Only this server is used; the others are ignored.

settings.form.llm.contextHint: How much text the local model reads at once: Ollama gets it as num_ctx, and LM Studio loads models with it. Assist needs about 16,384. 0 leaves it to the server.
settings.form.llm.sharesGpu: The local model shares the GPU with ComfyUI. A 4–8B model leaves room for generations.
settings.form.llm.ollamaUrlHint: Test checks Ollama answers and has the model.
settings.form.llm.ollamaModelHint: A model with tool calling for Assist, such as qwen3:8b. Pull it first: ollama pull qwen3:8b
